placements.why: Establishes the architectural stratum for asynchronous interaction contracts, dispatch lifecycles, and resilient status delivery mechanisms.
placements.title: standardizing asynchronous task execution, status polling, and reaction delivery
placements.frame: How do core service interfaces structure non-blocking job submission, receipt issuance, and execution tracking?

placements.title: from blocking synchronous calls to resilient asynchronous dispatch with cursor polling and piggybacked reactions
placements.frame: How should asynchronous extraction and dispatch contracts ensure work is preserved and non-blocking when receipts are dropped or results are retrieved across calls?
placements.why: Both Wynn and Xena define the ratified remember contract: returning immediate receipts, enabling cursor polling or piggybacked reactions, eliminating blocking calls, and preventing lost work if receipts drop.
